notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]New Game+[/h1]
You can now start a new game carrying over levels and gold from the previous save file, after completing the game. This should make Extreme easier for those who don't want to grind their levels from scratch.

[h1]Memory Leak Fix[/h1]
Fixed a nasty memory leak. There were reports of the game crashing to desktop after playing for a while. This shouldn't be a problem now.
